Plan: add flywheel loop stale/clear operator surfaces.
1. Read src/durable.rs (id_is_project_loop, roots-only, auto-clear from bd-87hq) + main.rs loop subcommands + tests layout.
2. Add `loop stale [--project P]`: resonate promises.search pending loop invocations, per project (id, age, owner-pid liveness via pid registry verdict).
3. Add `loop clear <project> [--all]`: reject stale roots (reuse id_is_project_loop), refuse when owner pid ALIVE.
4. Regression tests: dead vs alive pid verdict + all-projects aggregation.
5. cargo test + build; verify AC.
